name: full-conversion
command:
set -eu
mkdir -p /tmp/conversion /tmp/context /var/lib/buildkit/conversion/tree /tmp/check
printf '%s\n' 'FROM localhost/pinfold/full:latest' >/tmp/conversion/Dockerfile
buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/tmp/context --local dockerfile=/tmp/conversion --oci-layout localbase=/input --opt context:localhost/pinfold/full=oci-layout://localbase@sha256:b9ab91b85b2f7b0dbf13d49024587388a9e2150258fe78e22449ab5e23168364 --output type=tar,dest=/var/lib/buildkit/conversion/root.tar
tar --numeric-owner --xattrs --xattrs-include='*' -xpf /var/lib/buildkit/conversion/root.tar -C /var/lib/buildkit/conversion/tree
tree=/var/lib/buildkit/conversion/tree
kib=$(du -sk "$tree" | cut -f1)
entries=$(find "$tree" -print0 | tr -dc '\0' | wc -c)
size=$((kib + kib / 10 + entries / 4 + 16384))
echo ROOT_KIB=$kib ENTRIES=$entries OUTPUT_KIB=$size
test "$size" -le 524288
mkfs.ext4 -q -F -m 0 -O ^has_journal -N $((entries + 1024)) -d "$tree" /var/lib/buildkit/conversion/full.ext4 "$size"k
mount -o loop,ro /var/lib/buildkit/conversion/full.ext4 /tmp/check
stat /tmp/check/usr/bin/gh /tmp/check/usr/local/bin/bun /tmp/check/usr/local/bin/anydoc
test -d /tmp/check/opt/pinfold/packages/pi-fff
test "$(find /tmp/check -xdev -type f -perm /6000 | wc -l)" = 0
umount /tmp/check
du -sh /var/lib/buildkit
sync
